name: Relentless Cheer [Selfless, Teamwork]
body:
Your undying optimism keeps you and your companions going even when things get rough.

Prerequisite(s): Halfling, fearless and halfling luck ancestral traits.

Benefit(s): Adjacent allies gain a +1 morale bonus on all saving throws. This bonus increases to +3 on saving throws against fear.

Polymorph: Spiritual Ally, © 2026, Orphaned Bookworm Productions, LLC, Author: G. Tyler Ernst.
